identity.fallbackName.description: Shown where the viewer's name would be at the top of their own profile screen, when they have neither a display name nor a username.

identity.edit.description: Button on the viewer's own profile screen: opens the sheet where they change their photo, name and bio.

identity.buildingSince.description: Under the viewer's name on their profile: when they joined. {{date}} is a month and year, such as "March 2026". "Building" means making things on Homeroom.

identity.apps_one.description: Under the viewer's name on their profile. {{count}} is how many apps they have made.

identity.apps_other.description: Under the viewer's name on their profile. {{count}} is how many apps they have made.

line.factPair.description: Joins two short facts on one small line of the profile screen ("@ada · Building since March 2026", "Notes · sent today"). {{first}} is everything said so far and {{second}} the next fact, each already a complete phrase. Use the separator your language uses between such facts.

stats.live.description: Label under a number on the viewer's profile: how many of their changes were approved and are running. Lower case; an adjective.

stats.kudos.description: Label under a number on the viewer's profile: how many kudos (thank-yous from other members) they have received. Lower case.

stats.challenges.description: Label under a number on the viewer's profile: how many challenges they have completed this season. Lower case.

screen.loading.description: Accessible name of the grey placeholder shown while the viewer's profile is being fetched.

signedOut.text.text: Sign in to see your profile.
signedOut.text.description: Shown on the profile screen to a person who is not signed in.

signedOut.signIn.description: Button on the profile screen for a person who is not signed in: goes to the sign-in screen.

screen.loadFailed.text: Could not load your profile. Check your connection and try again.
screen.loadFailed.description: Shown on the profile screen when the viewer's own profile could not be fetched.

public.unavailable.description: Shown in place of another person's public profile when it does not exist or is not published.

public.report.description: Link under another person's public profile: opens the form for reporting that person to the moderators. "Report" is a verb.

work.heading.description: Heading over the first list of rows on the viewer's own profile: their changes, requests and votes.

work.changes.title.description: Row on the viewer's own profile, and the title of the screen it opens: the changes to projects they started. "Changes" is a noun.

work.changes.hint.description: Small line under "Your changes" on the viewer's profile when there are no counts to show.

work.changes.loadFailed.text: Your changes could not be loaded.
work.changes.loadFailed.description: Shown on the "Your changes" screen when the list could not be fetched. "Changes" is a noun.

work.changes.empty.text: You have not started a change yet.
work.changes.empty.description: Shown on the "Your changes" screen when the viewer has never started a change to a project. "Change" is a noun.

work.requests.title.description: Row on the viewer's own profile, and the title of the screen it opens: the improvements they asked for on projects. "Requests" is a noun.

work.requests.hint.text: What you asked for, and where it stands
work.requests.hint.description: Small line under "Your requests" on the viewer's profile when there are no counts to show.

work.requests.loadFailed.text: Your requests could not be loaded.
work.requests.loadFailed.description: Shown on the "Your requests" screen when the list could not be fetched. "Requests" is a noun.

work.requests.empty.text: You have not suggested an improvement yet.
work.requests.empty.description: Shown on the "Your requests" screen when the viewer has never asked for anything.

work.requests.suggest.description: Button at the foot of the "Your requests" screen: opens the form for asking for an improvement.

work.votes.title.description: Row on the viewer's own profile, and the title of the screen it opens: the changes and decisions they voted on.

work.votes.hint.text: The changes and decisions you voted on
work.votes.hint.description: Small line under "Your votes" on the viewer's profile when there is no latest vote to show. "Changes" is a noun.

work.votes.loadFailed.text: Your votes could not be loaded.
work.votes.loadFailed.description: Shown on the "Your votes" screen when the list could not be fetched.

work.votes.empty.text: You have not voted on anything yet.
work.votes.empty.description: Shown on the "Your votes" screen when the viewer has never voted.

work.votes.note.text: A vote can be changed while it is open, so each row says your vote as it stands.
work.votes.note.description: Note under the list on the "Your votes" screen. "Open" means the voting has not ended.

work.votes.latest.description: Small line under "Your votes" on the viewer's profile. {{title}} is the title of the change or decision they voted on most recently.

work.fold.allLive.description: Row at the end of the "Live" group on the "Your changes" screen when only the first few are shown: unfolds the rest. "Live" means changes that are running.

work.fold.allDecided.description: Row at the end of the "Decided" group on the "Your votes" screen when only the first few are shown: unfolds the rest.

work.changes.live_one.description: Small line under "Your changes" on the viewer's profile. {{number}} is how many of their changes are running, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

work.changes.live_other.description: Small line under "Your changes" on the viewer's profile. {{number}} is how many of their changes are running, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

work.changes.inProgress_one.description: Small line under "Your changes" on the viewer's profile. {{number}} is how many of their changes are still being worked on or voted on, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

work.changes.inProgress_other.description: Small line under "Your changes" on the viewer's profile. {{number}} is how many of their changes are still being worked on or voted on, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

work.requests.open_one.description: Small line under "Your requests" on the viewer's profile. {{number}} is how many of their requests are not finished, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. "Open" is an adjective.

work.requests.open_other.description: Small line under "Your requests" on the viewer's profile. {{number}} is how many of their requests are not finished, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. "Open" is an adjective.

work.requests.done_one.description: Small line under "Your requests" on the viewer's profile. {{number}} is how many of their requests are finished, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

work.requests.done_other.description: Small line under "Your requests" on the viewer's profile. {{number}} is how many of their requests are finished, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

more.heading.description: Heading over the second list of rows on the viewer's own profile.

more.appSlots.title.description: Row on the viewer's own profile: opens the dialog for creating an app, which says how many apps they may have. A "slot" is room for one app.

more.appSlots.hint.text: How many apps you can create
more.appSlots.hint.description: Small line under "App slots" on the viewer's profile when the numbers are not known yet.

more.challenges.title.description: Row on the viewer's own profile: opens the Leaderboard screen with the season's challenges and rankings.

more.challenges.hint.description: Small line under "Challenges & standings" on the viewer's profile when there is nothing more specific to show.

more.challenges.rank.description: Part of the small line under "Challenges & standings" on the viewer's profile. {{rank}} is their position in the season's ranking. Lower case.

more.challenges.done_one.description: Part of the small line under "Challenges & standings" on the viewer's profile. {{done}} is how many of the season's challenges they completed and {{count}} how many there are.

more.challenges.done_other.description: Part of the small line under "Challenges & standings" on the viewer's profile. {{done}} is how many of the season's challenges they completed and {{count}} how many there are.

more.kudos.title.description: Row on the viewer's own profile: opens the Kudos leaderboard. "Kudos" is the feature's name: thank-yous members give for changes.

more.kudos.hint.description: Small line under "Kudos" on the viewer's profile. "Changes" is a noun.

more.kudos.received_one.description: Summary of the kudos the viewer has been given, for the "Kudos" row of their profile. {{number}} is how many, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

more.kudos.received_other.description: Summary of the kudos the viewer has been given, for the "Kudos" row of their profile. {{number}} is how many, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

more.friends.title.description: Row on the viewer's own profile: opens their list of friends.

more.friends.hint.text: Only you can see your friends
more.friends.hint.description: Small line under "Friends" on the viewer's profile when no friend request is waiting.

more.friends.waiting_one.description: Small line under "Friends" on the viewer's profile. {{number}} is how many friend requests wait for their answer, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

more.friends.waiting_other.description: Small line under "Friends" on the viewer's profile. {{number}} is how many friend requests wait for their answer, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

more.settings.title.description: Row on the viewer's own profile: opens the Settings screen.

more.settings.hint.description: Small line under "Settings" on the viewer's profile: what is in there. "Keys" are API keys.

more.settings.hintWallet.description: Small line under "Settings" on the viewer's profile, for a person who has a wallet: what is in there. "Keys" are API keys.

more.settings.hintAdmin.description: Small line under "Settings" on the viewer's profile, for an administrator: what is in there. "Keys" are API keys; "admin" is the admin console.

more.settings.hintWalletAdmin.description: Small line under "Settings" on the viewer's profile, for an administrator who has a wallet: what is in there. "Keys" are API keys; "admin" is the admin console.

date.today.description: A date said relative to now, placed inside a longer line such as "sent today" or after an app's name. Lower case.

date.yesterday.description: A date said relative to now, placed inside a longer line such as "sent yesterday" or after an app's name. Lower case.

date.daysAgo_one.description: A date said relative to now, placed inside a longer line such as "sent 3 days ago" or after an app's name. {{count}} is a number of days from 2 to 13.

date.daysAgo_other.description: A date said relative to now, placed inside a longer line such as "sent 3 days ago" or after an app's name. {{count}} is a number of days from 2 to 13.

changes.group.inProgress.description: Heading on the "Your changes" screen over the changes still being worked on or voted on.

changes.group.live.description: Heading on the "Your changes" screen over the changes that were approved and are running. An adjective.

changes.group.closed.description: Heading on the "Your changes" screen over the changes that ended without going live. An adjective.

changes.fallbackTitle.description: Stands in for a change's title on the "Your changes" screen when it has none. A noun.

changes.state.waiting.description: After the app's name on a row of the "Your changes" screen: the change is being voted on. Lower case.

changes.state.inProgress.description: After the app's name on a row of the "Your changes" screen: the change is still being worked on. Lower case.

changes.state.closed.description: After the app's name on a row of the "Your changes" screen: the change was withdrawn or archived. Lower case.

requests.group.open.description: Heading on the "Your requests" screen over the requests that are not finished. An adjective.

requests.group.done.description: Heading on the "Your requests" screen over the requests that are finished, whether built or closed.

requests.fallbackTitle.description: Stands in for a request's title on the "Your requests" screen when it has none. {{number}} is the request's number. "Request" is a noun.

requests.anApp.description: Stands in for the app's name on a row of the "Your requests" screen when it is not known.

requests.state.waiting.description: After the app's name on a row of the "Your requests" screen: nobody has started working on the request. Lower case.

requests.state.underway.description: After the app's name on a row of the "Your requests" screen: somebody is working on the request. Lower case.

requests.state.shipped.description: After the app's name on a row of the "Your requests" screen: what was asked for has been built and is running. Lower case; an adjective.

requests.state.closed.description: After the app's name on a row of the "Your requests" screen: the request was closed without being built. Lower case; an adjective.

votes.group.open.description: Heading on the "Your votes" screen over the votes whose voting has not ended. "Open" is an adjective.

votes.group.decided.description: Heading on the "Your votes" screen over the votes whose outcome is settled.

votes.title.change.description: Stands in for the title of a change the viewer voted on, when it has none. {{number}} is the change's number. "Change" is a noun.

votes.title.aChange.description: Stands in for the title of a change the viewer voted on, when it has neither a title nor a number. "Change" is a noun.

votes.title.decision.description: Stands in for the title of a community decision the viewer voted on, when it has none.

votes.anApp.description: Stands in for the app's name on a row of the "Your votes" screen when it is not known.

votes.votedYes.description: On a row of the "Your votes" screen, after the app's name: the viewer's vote was yes. Lower case.

votes.votedNo.description: On a row of the "Your votes" screen, after the app's name: the viewer's vote was no. Lower case.

votes.outcome.live.description: On a row of the "Your votes" screen, after the viewer's vote: the change was approved and is running. Lower case; an adjective.

votes.outcome.goingLive.description: On a row of the "Your votes" screen, after the viewer's vote: the change was approved and is being put into the running project. Lower case.

votes.outcome.closed.description: On a row of the "Your votes" screen, after the viewer's vote: the change ended without going live. Lower case; an adjective.

votes.outcome.decided.description: On a row of the "Your votes" screen, after the viewer's vote: the community decision has been settled. Lower case.

feedback.title.description: Title of the sheet listing the feedback the viewer has sent.

feedback.close.description: Accessible name of the × button on the "Your feedback" sheet: closes the sheet. "Close" is a verb.

feedback.legend.text: Received: it was filed as a request. Counted: it earned points in the feedback challenge.
feedback.legend.description: Explanation at the top of the "Your feedback" sheet of its two status labels, "Received" and "Counted". Use the same words as those labels.

feedback.loadFailed.text: Your feedback could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
feedback.loadFailed.description: Shown in the "Your feedback" sheet when the list could not be fetched.

feedback.empty.text: Nothing sent yet. Feedback you send shows up here, with its status.
feedback.empty.description: Shown in the "Your feedback" sheet when the viewer has never sent feedback.

feedback.truncated.text: Showing the 50 you sent most recently.
feedback.truncated.description: Note under the list in the "Your feedback" sheet when the viewer has sent more than the 50 shown.

feedback.status.received.description: Status label on a row of the "Your feedback" sheet: the feedback was filed as a request.

feedback.status.counted.description: Status label on a row of the "Your feedback" sheet: the feedback earned points in the feedback challenge.

feedback.status.countedPoints_one.description: Status label on a row of the "Your feedback" sheet: the feedback earned points in the feedback challenge. {{points}} is how many, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural; "pts" abbreviates points.

feedback.status.countedPoints_other.description: Status label on a row of the "Your feedback" sheet: the feedback earned points in the feedback challenge. {{points}} is how many, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural; "pts" abbreviates points.

feedback.fallbackTitle.description: Stands in for the title of a piece of feedback in the "Your feedback" sheet when it has none.

feedback.anApp.description: Stands in for the app's name on a row of the "Your feedback" sheet when it is not known.

feedback.request.description: On a row of the "Your feedback" sheet, after the app's name: the request the feedback was filed as. {{number}} is its number. "Request" is a noun; lower case.

feedback.sent.description: On a row of the "Your feedback" sheet: when the feedback was sent. {{when}} is "today", "yesterday", "3 days ago" or a date such as "Mar 4". Lower case.

feedback.summary.none.description: Summary line of the feedback the viewer has sent, when there is none.

feedback.summary.sent_one.description: Summary line at the top of the "Your feedback" sheet. {{number}} is how many pieces of feedback the viewer has sent, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

feedback.summary.sent_other.description: Summary line at the top of the "Your feedback" sheet. {{number}} is how many pieces of feedback the viewer has sent, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

feedback.summary.sentCounted_one.description: Summary line at the top of the "Your feedback" sheet. {{number}} is how many pieces of feedback the viewer has sent, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. {{counted}} is how many of them earned points, also formatted.

feedback.summary.sentCounted_other.description: Summary line at the top of the "Your feedback" sheet. {{number}} is how many pieces of feedback the viewer has sent, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. {{counted}} is how many of them earned points, also formatted.

friends.title.description: Title of the sheet listing the viewer's friends, and the heading over the same list where it is shown on a page.

friends.close.description: Accessible name of the × button on the Friends sheet: closes the sheet. "Close" is a verb.

friends.label.description: Accessible name of the viewer's list of friends.

friends.accept.description: Button beside a friend request in the viewer's list of friends: accepts it.

friends.decline.description: Button beside a friend request in the viewer's list of friends: turns it down.

friends.cancelRequest.description: Button beside a friend request the viewer sent and that has not been answered: takes the request back.

friends.sentHeading.description: Heading over the friend requests the viewer sent that have not been answered.

friends.empty.text: No friends yet. Find someone by username above.
friends.empty.description: Shown in the viewer's list of friends when it is empty. "Above" is the search box over the list.

friends.loadFailed.text: Your friends could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
friends.loadFailed.description: Shown in the viewer's list of friends when it could not be fetched.

friends.privacy.text: Only you can see your friends. Nobody else sees this list or how long it is.
friends.privacy.description: Note at the foot of the viewer's list of friends.

friends.asked.description: Under the name of a person who sent the viewer a friend request. {{when}} is "today", "yesterday", "3 days ago" or a date such as "Mar 4".

friends.askedUndated.description: Under the name of a person who sent the viewer a friend request, when the date is not known.

friends.since.description: Under a friend's name in the viewer's list of friends. {{date}} is a month and year, such as "March 2026".

friends.sinceUndated.description: Under a friend's name in the viewer's list of friends, when the date they became friends is not known.

friends.requested.description: Under the name of a person the viewer sent a friend request to. {{when}} is "today", "yesterday", "3 days ago" or a date such as "Mar 4". A past participle: the friendship was requested.

friends.requestedUndated.description: Under the name of a person the viewer sent a friend request to, when the date is not known. A past participle: the friendship was requested.

message.button.description: Button on another person's profile: starts a private conversation with them. A verb.

message.buttonLabel.description: Accessible name of the Message button on another person's profile. "Message" is a verb. Keep the @ before the username.

message.nobody.text: There is nobody here to message.
message.nobody.description: Error shown when the Message button on a profile has no person to write to. "Message" is a verb.

message.unreachable.text: Couldn’t reach Messages. Check your connection and try again.
message.unreachable.description: Error shown when starting a conversation from a profile failed because the server could not be reached. "Messages" is the name of the Messages screen.

message.cannot.description: Error shown when the viewer may not start a conversation with this person. "Message" is a verb. Keep the @ before the username.

message.cannotNow.description: Error shown when a conversation with this person cannot be started at the moment. "Message" is a verb. Keep the @ before the username.

message.startFailed.text: Couldn’t start this conversation. Try again.
message.startFailed.description: Error shown when starting a conversation from a profile failed for an unknown reason.

edit.title.description: Title of the sheet where the viewer changes their photo, name and bio.

edit.saveFailed.description: Error shown in the Edit profile sheet when saving failed and the server gave no reason.

edit.saved.description: Brief message shown after the Edit profile sheet saved the viewer's changes.

edit.photo.group.description: Heading of the photo section of the Edit profile sheet.

edit.photo.label.description: Label beside the current photo in the Edit profile sheet.

edit.photo.note.text: PNG, JPEG or WebP. You choose the part that shows before it is used.
edit.photo.note.description: Note under "Profile photo" in the Edit profile sheet: the accepted image formats. Keep the format names.

edit.photo.noteNew.text: New photo, not saved yet. Press Save to use it.
edit.photo.noteNew.description: Note under "Profile photo" in the Edit profile sheet after a new photo was chosen. "Save" is the button at the foot of the sheet.

edit.photo.noteRemoved.text: Your photo will be removed when you press Save.
edit.photo.noteRemoved.description: Note under "Profile photo" in the Edit profile sheet after "Remove photo" was pressed. "Save" is the button at the foot of the sheet.

edit.photo.change.description: Row in the Edit profile sheet: opens the file picker to choose a new profile photo. "Change" is a verb.

edit.photo.remove.description: Row in the Edit profile sheet: removes the profile photo once the sheet is saved.

edit.photo.unusable.text: That image could not be used. Try a PNG, JPEG or WebP.
edit.photo.unusable.description: Error under the photo section of the Edit profile sheet when the chosen file failed for an unknown reason. Keep the format names.

edit.photo.wrongType.text: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
edit.photo.wrongType.description: Error under the photo section of the Edit profile sheet when the chosen file is not an accepted image format. Keep the format names.

edit.photo.unreadable.text: That image could not be read.
edit.photo.unreadable.description: Error under the photo section of the Edit profile sheet when the chosen file could not be decoded as an image.

edit.photo.unprocessable.text: That image could not be processed here.
edit.photo.unprocessable.description: Error under the photo section of the Edit profile sheet when this browser could not resize the chosen image.

edit.photo.removeFailed.description: Error shown in the Edit profile sheet when removing the profile photo failed and the server gave no reason.

edit.photo.uploadFailed.description: Error shown in the Edit profile sheet when uploading the new profile photo failed and the server gave no reason.

edit.name.group.description: Heading of the name section of the Edit profile sheet.

edit.name.label.description: Label of the field in the Edit profile sheet for the name other people see.

edit.name.note.text: The name other people see. Leave it empty to show your @handle.
edit.name.note.description: Note under the Display name field in the Edit profile sheet. "@handle" is the username with its @ sign.

edit.about.group.description: Heading of the section of the Edit profile sheet that holds the bio.

edit.about.bio.description: Label of the field in the Edit profile sheet for a few lines about oneself.

edit.public.group.description: Heading of the section of the Edit profile sheet about the profile page that people without an account can see.

edit.public.label.description: Label of the switch in the Edit profile sheet that publishes or unpublishes the viewer's public profile page.

edit.public.hidden.description: Under "Public profile" in the Edit profile sheet: moderators have taken the viewer's public page down.

edit.public.on.text: On: anyone with the link can view it, no account needed
edit.public.on.description: Under "Public profile" in the Edit profile sheet when the public page is published.

edit.public.off.text: Off: your profile has no public link
edit.public.off.description: Under "Public profile" in the Edit profile sheet when the public page is not published.

edit.public.open.description: Row in the Edit profile sheet: goes to the viewer's published public profile page. "Open" is a verb.

edit.public.copy.description: Row in the Edit profile sheet: copies the address of the viewer's public profile page to the clipboard.

edit.public.whatsOnIt.description: Row in the Edit profile sheet that unfolds a preview of the viewer's public profile page. "It" is the public page.

edit.public.moderationNote.text: You can keep editing or turn it off, but the public page stays unavailable.
edit.public.moderationNote.description: Note in the Edit profile sheet when moderators have taken the viewer's public page down. "It" is the Public profile switch.

edit.public.previewNote.text: Only your username, display name, bio, Homeroom-hosted photo and verified social accounts. Never your email, wallet, roles, memberships, unverified handles or private activity. Changes take effect at once, and nobody can search for the page.
edit.public.previewNote.description: Explanation over the preview of the viewer's public profile page in the Edit profile sheet: what the page shows and what it never shows. Homeroom is the product's name. "Changes" is a noun.

edit.public.copied.description: Status line in the Edit profile sheet after the public page's address was copied to the clipboard.

edit.public.copyManually.description: Status line in the Edit profile sheet when the public page's address could not be copied automatically. {{url}} is the address to copy by hand.

edit.public.publishing.description: Status line in the Edit profile sheet while the public page is being published.

edit.public.unpublishing.description: Status line in the Edit profile sheet while the public page is being taken down.

edit.public.updateFailed.description: Status line in the Edit profile sheet when publishing or unpublishing the public page failed and the server gave no reason.

edit.public.published.description: Brief message shown after the viewer's public profile page was published.

edit.public.unpublished.description: Brief message shown after the viewer's public profile page was taken down.

edit.social.group.description: Heading of the section of the Edit profile sheet listing the viewer's verified GitHub and X accounts.

edit.social.verified.description: Small green label beside a social account in the Edit profile sheet: the viewer proved the account is theirs.

edit.social.notShown.description: Beside GitHub or X in the Edit profile sheet when no verified account of that kind is shown on the profile.

edit.social.manage.description: Row in the Edit profile sheet: goes to the Settings section where social accounts are linked. "Change" is a verb.

edit.social.note.text: Provider verification and public visibility are managed separately in Settings.
edit.social.note.description: Note under the social accounts in the Edit profile sheet. "Provider" is GitHub or X.

edit.username.group.description: Heading of the username section of the Edit profile sheet.

edit.username.label.description: Label of the read-only field in the Edit profile sheet that shows the viewer's username.

edit.username.note.text: Your @handle is your sign-in name and your public page address. To change it, go to <0>Settings → Username</0>. To change only how your name appears, set a display name above.
edit.username.note.description: Note under the username in the Edit profile sheet. The numbered tag is a link to the Username section of Settings; "Settings → Username" is the path to it. "@handle" is the username with its @ sign.

edit.email.group.description: Heading of the email section of the Edit profile sheet.

edit.email.link.description: Row in the Edit profile sheet: goes to the Settings section for the account's email address and account recovery.

edit.email.note.text: Add or verify a private email address in Settings.
edit.email.note.description: Note under "Email & recovery" in the Edit profile sheet.

social.github.description: Link chip on a profile: the person's verified GitHub account. {{handle}} is their GitHub username.

social.x.description: Link chip on a profile: the person's verified X account. X is the social network's name. {{handle}} is their username there; keep the @ before it.

report.received.description: Status shown after the viewer's report about a person was sent to the moderators. "Report" is a noun.

report.failed.text: Could not send the report. Try again.
report.failed.description: Status shown when the viewer's report about a person could not be sent. "Report" is a noun.

crop.title.description: Title of the dialog where the viewer chooses which part of a new profile photo shows. "Position" is a verb.

crop.help.text: Drag to choose the part of your photo that shows in the circle. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
crop.help.description: Explanation in the photo-positioning dialog. "Save" is the button on the Edit profile sheet behind it.

crop.role.description: What a screen reader calls the draggable photo area in the photo-positioning dialog, in place of a generic role name. Lower case.

crop.stageLabel.text: Photo position. Drag to move the photo, or use the arrow keys. Plus and minus zoom.
crop.stageLabel.description: Accessible name of the draggable photo area in the photo-positioning dialog, with its keyboard instructions. "Plus" and "minus" are the + and − keys.

crop.zoom.description: Accessible name of the slider in the photo-positioning dialog that enlarges the photo.

crop.zoomValue.description: What a screen reader reads as the value of the zoom slider in the photo-positioning dialog. {{percent}} is a whole number from 100 to 400.

crop.preparing.description: Shown on the confirm button of the photo-positioning dialog while the photo is being cropped and resized.

crop.use.description: Button in the photo-positioning dialog: accepts the chosen part of the photo.

staking.title.description: Row in the wallet sheet, and the title and accessible name of the sheet it opens: the wallet's staking on the Usernode network.

staking.close.description: Accessible name of the × button on the Staking sheet: closes the sheet. "Close" is a verb.

staking.status.delegated.description: At the right of the Staking row: the wallet's stake is delegated to somebody else's validator.

staking.status.active.description: At the right of the Staking row: the wallet is staking by itself.

staking.status.checking.description: At the right of the Staking row while the wallet's staking state is being looked up.

staking.activeDot.description: At the top of the Staking sheet: the wallet is staking by itself. Keep the dot.

staking.manageInApp.text: Open the Homeroom app to manage delegation.
staking.manageInApp.description: Brief message shown when the delegate button is pressed in a staging preview of the Staking sheet. "Open" is a verb; Homeroom is the product's name.

staking.opening.description: Shown on the Delegate or Undelegate button of the Staking sheet while the wallet app is being opened.

staking.undelegate.description: Button on the Staking sheet: takes the wallet's stake back from the validator it was delegated to.

staking.delegate.description: Button on the Staking sheet: hands the wallet's stake to a validator. A verb.

staking.unavailable.text: Staking status is not available yet.
staking.unavailable.description: Shown in the Staking sheet when the wallet's staking state could not be determined.

staking.rechecking.description: Shown on the Retry button of the Staking sheet while the staking state is being looked up again.

staking.epoch.loading.description: Shown in the Staking sheet while the record of an epoch is being fetched. An epoch is a fixed period of the network's time.

staking.epoch.title.description: Heading of a card in the Staking sheet. {{epoch}} is the number of the epoch, a fixed period of the network's time.

staking.epoch.current.description: Small label on an epoch's card in the Staking sheet: this is the epoch now running. An adjective.

staking.epoch.completed.description: Small label on an epoch's card in the Staking sheet: this epoch has ended and its record is final.

staking.epoch.wonSlots.description: Label over a number on an epoch's card in the Staking sheet: how many block-producing slots the wallet won in that epoch.

staking.epoch.upcoming.description: Label under a number on an epoch's card in the Staking sheet: won slots whose time has not come yet.

staking.epoch.produced.description: Label under a number on an epoch's card in the Staking sheet: won slots in which the wallet produced a block.

staking.epoch.missed.description: Label under a number on an epoch's card in the Staking sheet: won slots in which the wallet failed to produce a block.

staking.epoch.unobserved.text: Some slots have no confirmed observation.
staking.epoch.unobserved.description: Note on an epoch's card in the Staking sheet: for some won slots it is not known whether a block was produced.

staking.epoch.collecting.text: Epoch data is still being collected.
staking.epoch.collecting.description: Shown on an epoch's card in the Staking sheet when its record exists but has no counts yet.

staking.epoch.history.description: Accessible name of the row of epoch cards in the Staking sheet that is swiped sideways.

staking.epoch.previous.description: Accessible name of the ‹ button under the epoch cards in the Staking sheet: shows the epoch before.

staking.epoch.next.description: Accessible name of the › button under the epoch cards in the Staking sheet: shows the epoch after.

staking.epoch.swipe.description: Hint between the two arrow buttons under the epoch cards in the Staking sheet.

staking.error.preview.description: Error shown in a staging preview of the Staking sheet when its sample data could not be fetched.

staking.error.epochData.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when an epoch's record could not be fetched and no reason is known.

staking.error.changed.text: The wallet or network changed. Retry to refresh epoch data.
staking.error.changed.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the fetched record belongs to a different wallet or network than expected. "Retry" is the button under it.

staking.error.network.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the blockchain network the wallet is on is not known.

staking.error.currentEpoch.text: Could not load the current epoch.
staking.error.currentEpoch.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the record of the epoch now running could not be fetched.

staking.error.misconfigured.text: The epoch data service is not configured correctly.
staking.error.misconfigured.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the address of the service that supplies epoch records is invalid.

staking.error.http.text: Epoch data service returned HTTP {{status}}. Please retry.
staking.error.http.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the service that supplies epoch records answered with an error. {{status}} is the numeric HTTP status code; keep "HTTP".

staking.error.emptyResponse.text: Epoch data service returned an empty response.
staking.error.emptyResponse.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the service that supplies epoch records answered with nothing.

staking.error.tooLarge.text: Epoch data response is too large.
staking.error.tooLarge.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the service that supplies epoch records sent more data than is accepted.

staking.error.invalidResponse.text: Epoch data service returned an invalid response.
staking.error.invalidResponse.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the answer of the service that supplies epoch records could not be read.

staking.error.timeout.text: Epoch data request timed out. Please retry.
staking.error.timeout.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the service that supplies epoch records took too long to answer.

staking.error.unreachable.text: Could not reach the epoch data service. Please retry.
staking.error.unreachable.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the service that supplies epoch records could not be contacted.

staking.error.wallet.text: A valid wallet address is required.
staking.error.wallet.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the wallet's address is missing or malformed.

staking.error.epoch.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the requested epoch number is malformed.

staking.error.notYet.text: Epoch data is not available yet.
staking.error.notYet.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the service has no usable record for the epoch yet.

staking.error.notStarted.text: That epoch has not started yet.
staking.error.notStarted.description: Error shown in the Staking sheet when the requested epoch is in the future.

breakdown.event.description: Stands in for an event's name in the list of where a person's points came from, when the event has no name. An event is a season or competition.

breakdown.bonus.description: Row in the list of where a person's points came from: points awarded by hand, outside any event.
